name: Shield

casting.casting_time: Reaction, which you take when you are hit by an attack roll or targeted by the Magic Missile spell

authored_intent: Reaction to being hit or targeted by Magic Missile; +5 AC including triggering hit through start of next turn; negate Magic Missile; must reach exact attack/cast route.

rules.text: An imperceptible barrier of magical force protects you.
Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from Magic Missile .
